conditions.A: PR28 default controller and fresh Mode1 initial state
conditions.B: PR28 default controller plus setpoints pressure=2800 kPa, level=65 percent, temperature=122.9 C
conditions.C: NOT_RUN: specific CSV lineage and fixed valve command semantics unverified

replay_gate: 2h means within 1e-6 absolute of PR28 means for pressure, level and temperature in both A and B, before 6h and 24h
termination_gate: STOP ALL subsequent runs on shutdown, nonfinite state or output, action outside 0..100, native/schema terminal constraint margin <= 0, numerical exception, replay mismatch, or job timeout 20 minutes; retain partial traces
recording: all steps examined; store every 6 steps and final, about 10.8 seconds; retain values at 2h, 6h and 24h
stability_diagnostic: for each of X7 X8 X9 at last 2h: absolute difference of the two one-hour means <=0.25 times benchmark standard deviation AND absolute fitted last-2h slope per hour <=0.25 times benchmark SD; descriptive stringent stationarity screen only, not operating safety or equivalence
integrator_test: NOT_RUN unless both 24h runs pass safety and time budget; do not change control period or infer same noise stream from seed
C_data_policy: do not fix valves using report alone without establishing exact benchmark file provenance and command/controller semantics
